content:
peter: FYI saw a weird pattern in eu-west during the 03:00 autoscaler cycle — lots of small GPU requests blocked, but autoscaler didn't open new nodes.
elaine: saw that too, pods pending with "nodeSelector: nvidia.com/gpu" and 'Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu' events. Any logs from the autoscaler? :thinking_face: 
jamal: autoscaler logs show a lot of 'no suitable nodes' and then 'skip scale up due to fragments' messages. suspect fragmentation across nodepools.
sophie: can you paste the flags for the running CA? might be something with expander or binpacking thresholds.
peter: current flags (from cluster):
```
--expander=most-pods
--balance-similar-node-groups
--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m
--scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.45
--max-node-provision-time=15m
--cores-total=0
```
jamal: hmm expander=most-pods tends to prefer nodes that will host many existing pods rather than minimizing GPU fragmentation. for GPU workloads we usually prefer least-waste or prioritized binpack.
elaine: agreed. Also scale-down-unneeded-time=10m might be too short and causing churn — nodes come up, few pods schedule, then scale-down kicks in when bursts clear.
sophie: we should also check nodepool weights and GPU packaging: one pool has 1xA100 per node, another pool has 4xA10s. CA might be choosing the wrong pool because of cost weight config.
sre-bot: alert: 12 pending pods for label "workload=gpu-batch" in eu-west-1, age>7m (detected 03:07 UTC).
peter: action proposal: switch expander to "least-waste" for GPU pools and increase --scale-down-unneeded-time to 30m. also bump --max-node-provision-time to 20m for spot pools.
jamal: also add a scheduling hint: prioritise packing by GPU count with a taint/toleration for low-priority jobs so they don't block critical inference pods.
elaine: we should simulate changes with scale simulator first. can someone run binpack sim against last 24h to estimate cost impact and fragmentation delta?
sophie: I'll run a quick sim. if switching to least-waste increases cost <6% but reduces pending by 90% it's worth it. I can also try a canary in eu-west-2 first.
peter: TL;DR checklist:
- change expander for GPU nodepools to least-waste
- set --scale-down-unneeded-time=30m
- set --max-node-provision-time=20m for spot pools
- add low-priority taint for batch jobs and a higher priority class for real-time jobs
- run binpack sim and canary in a single region
jamal: one more: adjust kubelet.eviction-hard for GPU nodes? we had nodes stuck in Terminating waiting on PV detach. maybe extend graceful termination to avoid lost caches.
elaine: noted. I'll open a quick RFC with the exact flag patch and rollout plan. who wants to be on the canary? :eyes: 
peter: I can push the canary today after Sophie posts sim results. thanks all.
